Definition: probably from the same as G4171, or perhaps from G4183; a town (properly, with walls, of greater or less size):--city.
BiblicalUsage: Polis is a city, a town with walls and gates and people. Jesus says, A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid, in Matthew 5:14. The holy city, new Jerusalem, comes down out of heaven in Revelation 21:2, and Abraham looked for a city which has foundations, whose builder and maker is God, in Hebrews 11:10. But here we have no continuing city, says Hebrews 13:14 — we seek one to come.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe every city I build will fall, and the city God builds will stand. That is why I hold that I am a stranger here, looking for the city whose builder is God.
RelatedTopics: Kingdom of God; New Creation; Hope
